newsitem.title: CHINA: No big change in health of China's Deng Xiaoping.
newsitem.headline: No big change in health of China's Deng Xiaoping.

text.p: The health of China's paramount leader Deng Xiaoping has not dramatically changed, a government spokesman said on Tuesday.
"There has been no big change," Chinese Foreign Ministry spokesman Shen Guofang told a news briefing when asked about the state of the 92-year-old Deng's health.
"For an old man, he is doing relatively well," Shen said. He declined further comment.
Deng has not been seen in public since early 1994. In his last appearance he looked frail and faltering.
Speculation abounds about his health, ranging from rumours he was admitted to hospital in recent days to reports he remains at home with little change in his health but with his lucidity failing.
